name: pdfpixels-mcp-server
title: PdfPixels PDF & Image Tools MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for PdfPixels — discover, search, and invoke 100+ free online PDF and image processing tools (compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, sign, redact, resize).

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search PdfPixels PDF and image tools by keyword, file format, or category.

query.description: Search keyword, format, or task (e.g. compress pdf, merge, ocr, heic to jpg)

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. pdf-organize, pdf-convert, image-compress)

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Get full metadata, accepted input/output formats, processing mode, max file size, and direct URL for a PdfPixels tool by slug.

slug.description: Tool slug (e.g. compress-pdf, merge-pdf, pdf-to-word, ocr-pdf)

tools.name: recommend_workflow
tools.description: Recommend the best PdfPixels tool or multi-step workflow for a user's document or image goal (including portal upload size limits like USCIS 2MB).

task.description: Description of the user's goal (e.g. 'compress a scanned PDF under 2MB for USCIS')

tools.name: get_platform_limits
